capabilities: Export a note or a whole folder as Word, PDF, EPUB or HTML
Turn each note in a folder into an ordered book chapter
Render math formulas and Mermaid diagrams in the exported files
Lay out Hebrew and Arabic paragraphs right-to-left beside English text
extras: Free, works fully offline and on mobile except PDF (desktop only, printed via Obsidian's Chromium with paged.js). After each export the result screen shows a small promotional card for the author's separate paid app PureWrite; the plugin itself needs no PureWrite purchase and shares book settings with it through a .purewrite-book.json file in the folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce book-ready DOCX, EPUB or paged PDF output, and exporting usually requires installing Pandoc, which also rules out mobile use.

relations.evidence: The export is built by the export engine of PureWrite, a focused Markdown writer for Mac, iPhone and iPad

summary: Export plugin that turns a note or folder into Word (DOCX), PDF, EPUB or HTML books with footnotes, math, Mermaid and RTL Hebrew/Arabic.
